title: L1 IntentClassifier input packet
description: Compact context packet handed to the L1 IntentClassifier at the start of every user turn. Qwen3 256k context window comfortably holds 16-reference-image generations and multi-segment storyboard frames; the runtime never silently drops artifacts. Trim only when measured budget pressure forces it. This contract is built deterministically by the host (browser or cloud runner) from explicit runtime state; it never re-derives semantics from transcript regex.

currentMessage.description: Raw user message text for this turn. Verbatim; sanitization belongs to boundary code, not this contract.

activeState.description: Currently-resolved focus state owned by the runtime (artifact graph + workflow runner). Populated from explicit runtime references — never from prose extraction.

pendingAction.description: Opaque reference to a runtime-tracked pending action (e.g. proposed plan awaiting selection). Shape is owned by the runtime, not this schema.

artifactState.description: Stable artifact identifiers owned by the ArtifactGraph. Qwen3 256k context window comfortably holds 16-reference-image generations and multi-segment storyboard frames; the runtime never silently drops artifacts. Trim only when measured budget pressure forces it.

selectedArtifactIds.description: Artifacts the user or planner has explicitly focused (e.g. multi-select for batch edit).

artifactIds.description: Full conversation artifact id list. UNBOUNDED by default. Qwen3 256k context window comfortably holds 16-reference-image generations and multi-segment storyboard frames; the runtime never silently drops artifacts. Trim only when measured budget pressure forces it.

recentTurns.description: Recent transcript window. UNBOUNDED by default. Qwen3 256k context window comfortably holds 16-reference-image generations and multi-segment storyboard frames; the runtime never silently drops artifacts. Trim only when measured budget pressure forces it. Sliding-window trimming from contextWindow.ts only fires after measured token budget pressure, and writes the trimmed prefix into conversationSummary.

conversationSummary.description: Rolling summary of trimmed prefix. Empty string until the first measured-budget-pressure trim event.

userPreferences.description: Free-form preference payload (e.g. preferred model tier, default aspect ratio). Deliberate exception: additionalProperties is true here, mirroring the data/metadata pattern in other contracts, because preferences evolve faster than the schema.

availableCapabilitiesSummary.description: Short human-readable capability strings the planner can quote when answering capability questions without invoking any tool.
